problems.problem: The agent used its world knowledge to identify that the United Kingdom of the Netherlands was the country with a different name, but failed to list it as a missing required evidence document since it was not present in the passages.

details.problem: The agent used its world knowledge to identify that the United Kingdom of the Netherlands was the country with a different name, but failed to list it as a missing required evidence document since it was not present in the passages.

codes.why: The agent used external parametric world knowledge to identify the country instead of relying on the provided text.
The agent failed to accurately track the evidence state by not listing the unretrieved country document as missing.
